title: 张飞 黄金 长坂护众

reference_roles.role: Approved Zhang Fei identity and build only; do not inherit blackiron shop, pose or robe.

QA.inspected: Full image and native face, both grips, full shaft/blade, armor/cloth, bridge/stone/water and tiger crops.
passes: Mature broad-faced tiger-bearded Zhang Fei identity and massive build retained.
Both hands wrap shaft with plausible fingers and wrists; all visible shaft segments straight and collinear.
On-foot bridge protection differs from Guan Yu mounted card; civilians behind to left and enemies beyond to right.
Continuous black/dark-red feline tiger, no dragon anatomy.
limitations: Snake-spear blade tip exits the right canvas. Full weapon frame safety not achieved; no unapproved repair.
Tiger upper ear/body reaches top boundary; needs final-frame safety assessment.
Dark cloth/armor contains some irregular warm abrasion flecks. Broad planar treatment improved but cannot certify zero isolated warm marks.
Very near enemy shoulders deliberately defocused; this card is not the story foreground-clear requirement.
QA.materials: Metal bevel/engraving highlights largely structural, matte red fabric broad planes. Wood follows grain; river foam/spray is water. Fine warm marks on dark surfaces require independent material audit.

independent_audit_1915.finding: Independent audit: identity, both grips, long straight shaft, black-red tiger armor and bridge protection narrative passed; warm marks judged decoration/wear rather than cross-material gold dust. Original blade-tip and tiger-ear safety did not pass.
independent_audit_1915.scope: Original candidate before the subsequently saved single local correction.
